explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/890, which records the observation liminf Σ ω_k(n+i) ≥ k − 1 via Pólya's theorem. The statement instead bounds the unrestricted sum: liminf Σ_{i<k} ω(n+i) ≥ k + π(k) − 1. This follows from the page's bound, since each of the π(k) primes ≤ k divides some n+i. So it is a true and closely related form, although the docstring quotes it as the [ErSe67] observation rather than the page's ω_k version. Faithful in substance.
